subject: hm-image-commands
description: image-sdk's edit commands (docs/formats/hm-image-plan.md). input.plan is an hm-image-plan document and input.command an hm-image-command; expected is the resulting document, or the rejection. Applying the command's inverse must restore the plan, but the inverse itself is internal. Generated cases come from the reducer's property-test generators, with a fixed seed.
